annotations.description: For 2 minutes, more than 2% of the requests that ingress-nginx routed through Ingress royal-road/royal-road-admin to Service royalroad-admin returned 5xx (5.4% over the last 5 minutes, above 1 request/s). 502, 503 and 504 usually mean the backend pods are not ready, crash-looping or timing out; 500 comes from the application itself. Open the workload's Observe tab in the console to line this up with rollouts, restarts and new errors.
annotations.summary: royal-road/royal-road-admin: 5.4% of requests to Service royalroad-admin return 5xx
